AssociateAlias.name: AssociateAlias
AssociateAlias.description: Associate an alias. You can associate the alias of a key to another key.

BatchCreateKmsTags.name: BatchCreateKmsTags
BatchCreateKmsTags.summary: Batch Adding or Deleting Key Tags
BatchCreateKmsTags.description: - Description: This API is used to add or delete key tags in batches.

CancelGrant.name: CancelGrant
CancelGrant.description: - Description: This API is used to revoke the key operation permissions of a grantee. - Note: - Only the user who created the CMK can revoke a grant.

CancelKeyDeletion.name: CancelKeyDeletion
CancelKeyDeletion.description: - Description: This API is used to cancel the scheduled deletion of a key. - Note: You can cancel the scheduled deletion of a key only if the key is in **Pending deletion** state.

CancelSelfGrant.name: CancelSelfGrant
CancelSelfGrant.description: - Description: This API is used to retire a grant. After a grant is retired, the grantee no longer has the permission to perform operations on the granted key. For example, user A grants user B the permission to operate on key A, and grants user C the permission to revoke the grant. In this case, users A, B, and C can…

CreateDatakey.name: CreateDatakey
CreateDatakey.description: - Description: This API is used to create a DEK. The returned result contains plaintexts and ciphertexts.

CreateDatakeyWithoutPlaintext.name: CreateDatakeyWithoutPlaintext
CreateDatakeyWithoutPlaintext.description: - Description: This API is used to create a DEK. The returned result only contains ciphertexts.

CreateEcDatakeyPair.name: CreateEcDatakeyPair
CreateEcDatakeyPair.summary: Create a data key pair for ec algorithm.
CreateEcDatakeyPair.description: - Function: When you create a data key pair, there are plaintext public key and ciphertext private key in the output. Whether the plaintext private key is returned is determined on the parameter.

CreateGrant.name: CreateGrant
CreateGrant.description: - Description: This API is used to create a grant. A grantee can perform operations on a granted key. - Note: - The aliases of default master keys (aliases ended with **/default**) cannot be granted.

CreateKey.name: CreateKey
CreateKey.description: This API is used to create a CMK, which can be symmetric or asymmetric. - A symmetric key is a 256-bit AES key. It can be used to encrypt a small amount of data or encrypt DEKs. - An asymmetric key can be an RSA key pair or an ECC key pair, which can be used for data encryption and decryption, digital signature, and s…

CreateKeyStore.name: CreateKeyStore
CreateKeyStore.description: - "This API is used to create a dedicated tenant keystore. Keys are stored in a Dedicated HSM instance."

CreateKmsTag.name: CreateKmsTag
CreateKmsTag.description: - Description: This API is used to add a key tag.

CreateParametersForImport.name: CreateParametersForImport
CreateParametersForImport.description: - Description: This API is used to obtain parameters required for importing a key, including an import token and a public key. - Note: The returned public key type is RSA_2048 by default.

CreatePin.name: CreatePin
CreatePin.description: This API is used to create a PIN, which is used to create and encrypt a DEK in the level-4 cryptography testing scenario.

CreateRandom.name: CreateRandom
CreateRandom.description: - Description: This API is used to generate a random number that is 8 bits to 8,192 bits long.

CreateRsaDatakeyPair.name: CreateRsaDatakeyPair
CreateRsaDatakeyPair.summary: Create a data key pair for rsa algorithm.
CreateRsaDatakeyPair.description: - Function: When you create a data key pair, there are plaintext public key and ciphertext private key in the output. Whether the plaintext private key is returned is determined on the parameter.

DecryptData.name: DecryptData
DecryptData.description: - Description:This API is used to decrypt data.

DecryptDatakey.name: DecryptDatakey
DecryptDatakey.description: - Description: This API is used to decrypt a DEK by using a specified CMK.

DeleteImportedKeyMaterial.name: DeleteImportedKeyMaterial
DeleteImportedKeyMaterial.description: - Description: This API is used to delete key materials.

DeleteKey.name: DeleteKey
DeleteKey.description: - Description: This API is used to specify the number of days after which a key will be deleted. It can be 7 to 1,096 days.

DeleteKeyStore.name: DeleteKeyStore
DeleteKeyStore.description: This API is used to delete a dedicated keystore.

DeleteTag.name: DeleteTag
DeleteTag.description: - Description: This API is used to delete a key tag.

DisableKey.name: DisableKey
DisableKey.description: - Description: This API is used to disable a key. A disabled key cannot be used. - Note: Only an enabled key can be disabled.

DisableKeyRotation.name: DisableKeyRotation
DisableKeyRotation.description: - Description: This API is used to disable CMK rotation.

DisableKeyStore.name: DisableKeyStore
DisableKeyStore.description: This API is used to disable a dedicated keystore.

EnableKey.name: EnableKey
EnableKey.description: - Description: This API is used to enable a key. A key can be used only after it is enabled. - Note: Only a disabled key can be enabled.

EnableKeyRotation.name: EnableKeyRotation
EnableKeyRotation.description: - Description: This API is used to enable CMK rotation. - Note: - The default rotation interval is 365 days. - CMKs created using imported key materials and default master keys do not support rotation.

EnableKeyStore.name: EnableKeyStore
EnableKeyStore.description: This API is used to enable a dedicated keystore.

EncryptData.name: EncryptData
EncryptData.description: - Description: This API is used to encrypt data by using a specified CMK.

EncryptDatakey.name: EncryptDatakey
EncryptDatakey.description: - Description: This API is used to encrypt a DEK by using a specified CMK.

GenerateMac.name: GenerateMac
GenerateMac.description: This API is used to generate a message authentication code.

ImportKeyMaterial.name: ImportKeyMaterial
ImportKeyMaterial.description: - Description: This API is used to import key materials.

ListAliases.name: ListAliases
ListAliases.description: Obtain all aliases associated to a key.

ListGrants.name: ListGrants
ListGrants.description: - Description: This API is used to query the grant list of a key.

ListKeyDetail.name: ListKeyDetail
ListKeyDetail.description: - Description: This API is used to query the details about a key.

ListKeys.name: ListKeys
ListKeys.description: - Description: This API is used to query all the keys of a user.

ListKeyStores.name: ListKeyStores
ListKeyStores.description: This API is used to query a user's dedicated keystore list.

ListKmsByTags.name: ListKmsByTags
ListKmsByTags.description: - Description: This API is used to query a key instance. You can use tags to filter and check CMK details.

ListKmsTags.name: ListKmsTags
ListKmsTags.description: - This API is used to query the tags of a user in a project.

ListRetirableGrants.name: ListRetirableGrants
ListRetirableGrants.description: - Description: This API is used to query grants that can be retired.

ListSupportRegions.name: ListSupportRegions
ListSupportRegions.summary: Querying the regions supported by the mutil-region key function.
ListSupportRegions.description: Querying the regions supported by the mutil-region key function.

ReEncrypt.name: ReEncrypt
ReEncrypt.description: Decrypt the ciphertext using the source key and then use a specified key for encryption. Re-encrypt the DEK ciphertext encrypted with CreateDatekey, CreateDatakeyWithoutPlainText, and EncryptDatakey into new DEK ciphertext. Re-encrypt the ciphertext encrypted with EncryptData into new ciphertext.

ReplicateKey.name: ReplicateKey
ReplicateKey.summary: Replicating a key to a specified region
ReplicateKey.description: Replicating a key to a specified region.

ShowKeyRotationStatus.name: ShowKeyRotationStatus
ShowKeyRotationStatus.description: - Description: This API is used to query CMK rotation.

ShowKeyStore.name: ShowKeyStore
ShowKeyStore.description: This API is used to obtain a dedicated keystore.

ShowKmsTags.name: ShowKmsTags
ShowKmsTags.description: - Description: This API is used to query a key tag.

ShowPublicKey.name: ShowPublicKey
ShowPublicKey.description: - This API is used to query the public key information of a specified asymmetric key.

ShowUserInstances.name: ShowUserInstances
ShowUserInstances.description: - Description: This API is used to query the number of instances, that is, the number of CMKs created by a user.

ShowUserQuotas.name: ShowUserQuotas
ShowUserQuotas.description: - Description: This API is used to query quota, including the total number of CMKs that can be created by a user and the current quota usage.

ShowVersion.name: ShowVersion
ShowVersion.description: - Description: This API is used to query a specified API version.

ShowVersions.name: ShowVersions
ShowVersions.description: - Description: This API is used to query the API version list.

Sign.name: Sign
Sign.description: - Description: This API is used to use the private key of an asymmetric key to digitally sign a message or digest.

UpdateKeyAlias.name: UpdateKeyAlias
UpdateKeyAlias.description: - Description: This command is used to modify the alias of a CMK. - Note: - The aliases of Default master keys (aliases ended with **/default**) cannot be modified. - A key alias cannot be changed if the key is in **Pending deletion** state.

UpdateKeyDescription.name: UpdateKeyDescription
UpdateKeyDescription.description: - Description: This API is used to modify the description of a CMK. - Note: - The aliases of default master keys (aliases ended with **/default**) cannot be modified. - Key description cannot be modified if the key is in **Pending deletion** state.

UpdateKeyRotationInterval.name: UpdateKeyRotationInterval
UpdateKeyRotationInterval.description: - Description: This API is used to modify CMK rotation.

UpdatePrimaryRegion.name: UpdatePrimaryRegion
UpdatePrimaryRegion.summary: Update the primary region of a key.
UpdatePrimaryRegion.description: Update the primary region to which the key belongs. After the changing, the current region becomes a replica region.

ValidateSignature.name: ValidateSignature
ValidateSignature.description: - Description: This API uses the private key of an asymmetric key to verify a signature.

VerifyMac.name: VerifyMac
VerifyMac.description: This API is used to verify message authentication code.
